author: bardic-inspiration
name: Dawnforged Longsword
summary: A radiant longsword that blazes on command and bends a day's end to its bearer's will.
description: Cast from the first lamp a long-dead order lit at the edge of a dark country. Its bearers say it hums when the sun comes up.

stats.effect:
You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a Bonus Action, you can cause the blade to blaze for 1 minute. While it blazes, it deals an extra 3d6 Radiant damage on a hit and sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

***Radiant Rebuke.*** When a creature within 30 feet of you hits you with an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to deal 3d6 Radiant damage to the attacker. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
